ret: 1 training day (A) holding 1 exercise, over block weeks train ×4, once.
Block weeks: train, train, train, train, once. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 2.5 kg grid.
Rotation: Each training week: Day A, then Day A, then Day A.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 3 times in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
bench: 4 sets of Barbell Bench Press in the phase rep range, starting at the benchStart handed on by the previous phase; add 2.5 kg once every set reaches the top of the range.

ret.start: the benchStart handed on by the previous phase

args.start: the benchStart handed on by the previous phase

ret: 4 sets of Barbell Bench Press in the phase rep range, starting at the benchStart handed on by the previous phase; add 2.5 kg once every set reaches the top of the range
Reads your estimated max (kept on file; ignored once older than 56 days).

Starts with working weight = whichever is known first: (1) the benchStart handed on by the previous phase; (2) the load you could lift for 12 reps with 2 in reserve, given an estimated max of your estimated max for Barbell Bench Press; written by session, owner.
Plan: Barbell Bench Press: 4 sets of 8–12 reps at your working weight.

After each session: Set working weight to whichever is known first: (1) (if every working set reached the top of its range: your working weight plus 2.5 kg; if a working set fell short: your working weight; if nothing fell short but something went unlogged: your working weight); (2) the best load you logged on “work”.
